outcome: Reasons for choosing vaginal or cesarean delivery
cohort: 23,940 postpartum women in Brazil who gave birth in 2011-2012
finding: The proportion of cesarean sections in Brazil was much higher than the women's initial preference, particularly in the private sector where there was an increase in decision for cesarean birth towards the end of gestation.
mod_finding: The initial preference for cesarean delivery was 27.6%, ranging from 15.4% among primiparous women in the public sector to 73.2% among multiparous women with previous cesarean in the private sector.
